name: tasksync
description: TaskSync — internal task management for Omnifi (web dashboard, API and Windows desktop companion)

scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && npm run test -w server && npm run test -w web
scripts.publish:desktop: dotnet publish desktop/TaskSync.Desktop -c Release -r win-x64 --self-contained false -p:PublishSingleFile=true -o desktop/publish/TaskSync
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w shared && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
